userText: Last Saturday our family went to the beach for the first time this year. My daughter held my hand tightly because the cold waves surprised her, but soon she was running along the shore and collecting shells. We built a large sandcastle together, and my husband took photos of us while the sun was going down. Although we were tired on the way home, everyone agreed it was the best day of the month.

errorSentences: 未使用目标词 'free expression'；整段为描述性记叙，虽语言自然、语法正确，但未体现‘自由表达’主题（如观点、感受、创意、个性表达等）；A1 学习者应尝试用简单句表达个人想法（如 'I liked it because...' 'I felt happy when...'），而非仅客观叙述事件。
suggestions: A1 学习者可加入1–2句简单主观表达，例如：'I felt so happy!' 或 'My daughter said, "I love the beach!"' —— 这样既符合水平，又真正体现 free expression。不必复杂，真诚的短句就是自由表达的开始。
